name: HL Corp (Shenzhen)
summary: HL Corp (Shenzhen) specializes in the development, manufacturing, and distribution of cycling components, athletic gear, and mobility assistance devices. Primarily operating within the People's Republic of China, the company's product portfolio includes essential bicycle parts such as handlebars, stems, seat posts, and suspension forks. Beyond cycling accessories, the firm also produces a wide array of sports and fitness equipment. This range features children's three-wheel scooters, trikers, push bikes, versatile 2-in-1 scooters, wingflyers, and kick scooters, alongside e-bikes, mountain bikes, and trekking bikes. In the health and rehabilitation sector, HL Corp manufactures various medical aids, including wheelchairs, tri-walkers, rollators, cane products, overbed tables, and specialized commode and shower chairs. All these products are offered under their proprietary ZOOM brand. While a significant player in the domestic Chinese market, the company also extends its reach internationally, exporting its goods to key regions like Europe, the United States, and across Asia. HL Corp (Shenzhen) was established in 1991 and is headquartered in Shenzhen, People's Republic of China.
